title: Remote Live Multiplayer & Presence
objective: Deliver reliable remote Campaign play around the existing Campaign/Session/Action/Event authority model.

scope.purpose: Deliver reliable remote Campaign play around the existing Campaign/Session/Action/Event authority model.
scope.completion_gate: Geographically separated ordinary users can join, play, disconnect/recover and continue without developer intervention or duplicate authoritative effects.

validation_notes: The first implementation candidate passed the SMB-02 focused test and current source-governance invariants, then exposed a retired Phase-9 verifier that depended on a deleted historical workflow.

The obsolete Phase-9 verifier was not revived. The terminal profile instead used current SMB/MIB regressions plus direct source-foundation checks while preserving the completed P9/GATX evidence as history.
The exact validated application tree is identical to the squash-merged application tree.
selection_boundaries: SMB-01 was completed_verified before SMB-02 implementation.
Campaign/Session/Action/Event authority remains canonical; remote transport and presence do not create parallel authoritative effects.
Presence, device identity and transport role claims remain non-authoritative.
Reconnect uses current authorization plus governed checkpoint and ordered Event history rather than caller-supplied state.
Paid/live provider activation, production deployment and public/tester distribution remain separately gated.
SMB-03 and later implementation remain unauthorized until separately governed-started.
next_action: SMB-02 is completed_verified. Canonical product state advances to SMB-03 selected_not_started; do not start SMB-03 without a later owner Continue.
